test_title: PYST 10: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - Reasoning (Held On: 15th Sep 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: How many meaningful four-letter English words can be formed using the first, second, third, and fourth letters of the word "PLANET" (when counted from left to right), using each letter only once in each word?
solution:
Given Word:"PLANET" 

 
• The word PLANET → first four letters (from left to right):
 
• P, L, A, N
 
• Now form meaningful four-letter English words, using each letter only once.
 
• meaningful four-letter English words : 1
 
• PLAN 
 
• All other combination (PALN, NAPL, ALPN, etc.) are not valid English words.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**
